core_types.name: Configuration
core_types.description: Action environment holding Kubernetes client, driver storage, and logger

core_types.name: Chart
core_types.description: Packaged or unpacked Helm chart containing templates, values, and metadata

core_types.name: Storage
core_types.description: Release history backend persisting releases in Kubernetes Secrets or ConfigMaps

call_paths.path: engine.Render() -> Go template execution -> manifest YAML stream

concurrency_model.type: Single-Threaded Action Runner with Parallel Kubernetes Resource Creation
concurrency_model.synchronization: Kubernetes cluster-side atomic secrets updates; optional release mutex locks

cancellation_model.deadline_propagation: context.Context controls action duration and Kubernetes API timeouts
cancellation_model.leak_prevention: Action timeout triggers release rollback or failure recording in storage

retry_model.strategy: Kubernetes resource readiness polling with configurable timeout (e.g., --wait)

boundaries.network: HTTPS calls to Helm chart repositories (OCI / HTTP) and Kubernetes API server
boundaries.os: Local cache (~/.cache/helm) and temporary chart archive tar extraction
boundaries.serialization: YAML manifests, Go templates, and JSON release envelopes
